independence_evidence: About page: 'Acid Magazine is a fully independant annual print publication', edited by three named editors, printed in Brittany; no parent company.
qualifies_reason: Independent French annual whose No8 shipped from 28 September 2026 (No7 in 2025).
what_it_is: Acid Magazine is a thick, bilingual French and English annual that uses surfing as a way into wider subjects: oceanography, coastal economies, environmental questions, art, fashion and history. No8, 'Liquid After All', runs 400 pages and 15 stories in a compact 235 x 168 mm format, issued with four different covers sent at random. It is for readers of surf and ocean culture who want essays and photography rather than contest coverage or gear.

No8 has four covers sent at random; only one cover design was found as an image, and no flat publisher image exists (the publisher uses product photographs).
